hooks.command:
cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" 2>/dev/null || exit 0
changed=$( { git diff --name-only -- src; git diff --cached --name-only -- src; git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -- src; } 2>/dev/null | grep -E '\.(js|jsx)$' | sort -u)
if [ -z "$changed" ]; then exit 0; fi
hash=$(echo "$changed" | shasum | cut -d' ' -f1)
marker=".git/.bug-fixes-hook-hash"
last=$(cat "$marker" 2>/dev/null || echo "")
if [ "$hash" = "$last" ]; then exit 0; fi
echo "$hash" > "$marker"
printf '{"decision":"block","reason":"Uncommitted src/ changes have not been checked against docs/BUG-TRIAGE-AND-FEATURE-ROADMAP.md yet. Invoke the bug-fixes subagent (Agent tool, subagent_type: bug-fixes) to review the diff, then finish."}'
hooks.statusMessage: Checking new code against bug triage…
